resolved.title: 数组 Array
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

An [b]array[/b] is a sequence of elements of the same type.

An array is defined using square brackets which define the number of elements the array will hold.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]var a [5]int [/code]
Now [b]a[/b] is an array of 5 integers.

You can also define and initialize values of the array using the following syntax:[code format="go" ]a := [5]int{0, 2, 4, 6, 8} [/code]
[note]As you can see, we need to provide the size of the array when declaring it. This means that arrays have a fixed size.[/note]

**数组**(array)是由**相同类型**的元素组成的序列。

一个数组是用方括号`[]`定义的，方括号中数字定义了数组的长度。

**例如：**
content.text_html:
An array is a sequence of elements of the same type.

An array is defined using square brackets which define the number of elements the array will hold.

For example:

一个数组是由相同类型的元素组成的序列。

一个数组是用方括号定义的，方括号定义了数组将容纳的元素数量。

例如：

content.content:

var a [5]int

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

After declaring the array, we can access its elements using square brackets and their [b]indexes[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For example: [/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3341"]var a [5]int

a[0] = 8
a[1] = 42

fmt.Println(a[1])[/code]
Each element of an array has its unique index, starting with 0. The first element has the index 0, the second element has the index 1, and so on.

You can assign values to array elements, as well as retrieve their value.
[note]By default, the elements of the array are initialized to the zero value of the given type. [/note]

content.text:
在声明数组之后，我们可以使用方括号`[]`和**索引**来访问数组元素。

**比如：**
content.text_html:
After declaring the array, we can access its elements using square brackets and their indexes.

**For example: **

在声明了数组之后，我们可以使用方括号和它们的**索引来访问它的元素。

比如说。

content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  var a [5]int

  a[0] = 8
  a[1] = 42

  fmt.Println(a[1])
}

content.text:
数组的每个元素都有**唯一**索引，从`0`开始。
- 第1个元素的索引是0
- 第2个元素的索引是1，以此类推。

你可以给数组元素赋值，也可以访问它们的值。
content.text_html:
Each element of an array has its unique index, starting with 0. The first element has the index 0, the second element has the index 1, and so on.

You can assign values to array elements, as well as retrieve their value.

数组的每个元素都有其唯一的索引，从0开始。第一个元素的索引是0，第二个元素的索引是1，以此类推。

你可以给数组元素赋值，也可以检索它们的值。

content.text: 默认情况下，数组的元素被初始化为给定类型的零值。
content.text_html:
By default, the elements of the array are initialized to the zero value of the given type.

默认情况下，数组的元素被初始化为给定类型的零值。

resolved.title: 菜单
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设正在制作一个数字菜单应用程序。
菜单的选择项存储在数组**menu**中。

输入一个数字，表示选择的菜单项，并从菜单中输出相应的项目。
如果该索引无效，应用程序输出 "**无效选择**"。

输入表示数组的索引，即`0`对应的是第一项。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Menu[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a digital Menu App. 
The menu choices are stored in an array called [b]menu[/b].

You need to take a number as input, which indicates the choice index, and output the corresponding item from the menu.
In case the index is not valid, your app should output "[b]Invalid choice[/b]".
The input indicates the index of the array, meaning 0 corresponds to the first item.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
2

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
Cake

[note]The [b]menu[/b] array is already defined in the code.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 代码中已经定义了**menu**数组，请勿更改。
